name: reply-handling
description: Classifies and automates responses to cold email replies using an 8-category taxonomy, auto-reply playbooks, and human escalation rules. Use when the user asks to set up reply handling, needs reply classification logic, wants auto-responder templates for common replies, or needs escalation rules for human handoff. Activates on phrases like "handle cold email replies," "auto reply to outbound," "reply classification," "meeting booked response," "not interested reply," or "escalate to AE."
